name: Order Number One
why_it_works: Order #0001 turns a faceless online store into a person at a kitchen table. Viewers love being early to something, and seeing how much the first sale meant makes their own order feel like it matters too. That feeling beats a discount.

hook.pattern: Show the literal first receipt or order number, then reveal who it came from.
examples: Order #0001. It came from my grandma.
Our first sale was $14 and I screamed.
This packing slip hangs framed above our desk.

variables.name: product
variables.description: The product in that first order

variables.name: first_customer
variables.description: Who placed the first order, as specific as is fair to share, spoken, 9 words or fewer
variables.example: a stranger in Ohio who found our hashtag

variables.name: struggle
variables.description: The real struggle at that stage, with a real number, spoken, 11 words or fewer
variables.example: zero sales in 41 days, and I almost shut it down

variables.name: why_it_mattered
variables.description: What the first order meant, spoken, 10 words or fewer
variables.example: someone we'd never met believed it was worth paying for

variables.name: offer
variables.description: What the viewer gets now, starting with a capital letter, spoken, 4 words or fewer

variables.name: order_count
variables.description: The real number of orders shipped so far

variables.name: use_tip
variables.description: One practical how-to-use tip for the product, a full sentence
variables.example: Warm a pea-sized amount between your fingers before you apply it.

craft.notes: Build the whole story around one physical artifact, the first receipt. The struggle beat should include a real number (days, dollars, followers) so it feels true. Close on a ritual that continues today, so the viewer can take part in the story by ordering.

do_not: Fake an order number or invent the first customer
Make product claims inside the emotional story
Show a customer's full name or address on the slip
compliance: Supplements: no disease or treatment claims; any structure/function claim needs the FDA disclaimer 'These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration'
Skincare: no claims that the product cures or treats skin conditions
Blur names and addresses on any real order slip shown
No guaranteed skin or body results from the product; label AI-generated founder or scene images with the platform's AI-content label
